dormitories.name: Dormitories
dormitories.description: Your small dormitory room off the right plaza: a bed, a desk, and a wardrobe.

right_plaza.name: Right Plaza
right_plaza.description: The dormitories' plaza. The residence halls stand along one side, and a garden road leads off beneath a stone arch.

main_plaza.name: Main Plaza
main_plaza.description: The heart of the academy. The Dueling Palace and the main academic building face each other across the square, and paved roads branch to the left and right plazas.

main_academic_building.name: Main Academic Building
main_academic_building.description: Rows of desks beneath a vaulted, rune-carved ceiling. The academy's core lectures are held here.

secondary_academic_building.name: Secondary Academic Building
secondary_academic_building.description: An annexe of smaller halls and workshops off the main plaza, where the practical courses meet.

dueling_palace.name: Dueling Palace
dueling_palace.description: A sand-floored arena warded for magical combat, its galleries hung with duelling trophies.

description.text: Terraced gardens beyond the dormitories' plaza. To your trained sense the ward-lines threaded through the hedges glow faintly, a slow tide of mana pooling in the old stone basins.
Terraced gardens beyond the dormitories' plaza, quiet and green under the dusk.
